evidence.detail: Passed. Row enrollment/authority-refuses-domain-store-conflict is green in one run of suite 113_veldo_0117_domain_store at c3b054f5, 45 of 45 checks true. Unit authorities (24 checks): two clones with their own Git directories and clone uuids are bound by valid signatures; the second clone's binding is varied over the eight combinations of equal and unequal domain, store uuid and canonical location. The matching binding is accepted into the committed store. Each of the three same-domain conflicts is domain_store_conflict both at admission and for the signed command, with no transaction in either store. Production path (21 checks): control_service.install lays two instances of one domain down in one install root, bound to two stores, and the suite runs each installed control_service.py serve as its unit does, handing neither a registry. The first registers its store in the install root's registry. The second is told domain_store_conflict at its start. The committed store's clone is accepted; the other store's clone is refused domain_store_conflict by the running service, naming the committed and the proposed store, with every table of both stores unchanged; a binding naming another store uuid at the committed file is refused the same way by the committed store's own instance. Each refusal is in the instance's observations. The same holds after both are stopped and started again, the conflicting one first. The clones use the production client, whose resolver returns the conflicting store without complaint. Stores and registry are read back by plain read-only sqlite3 connections.

The row must be red on the three same-domain conflict cases and on the two production refusals (the installed service of f6b8ae41 serves a store its domain is not bound to), and not because a section raised. Written to proof/VELDO-0117/red-before.summary.json.

Pending, step teeth: mutants v117-binding-comparison-removed, v117-registration-comparison-removed, v117-judgment-skips-registry and v117-unregistered-domain-served (finding 117, scripts/check_teeth_mutations.py) must turn the row red. The first three are the declared falsifier, the comparison removed at each place the authority makes it. Two more are in .veldo/control_service.py and must turn the row red on its production checks: v117-service-passes-no-registry (the service builds its authority without the registry, which removes the wiring) and v117-service-registry-per-installation (each installation keeps a registry of its own). Written to proof/VELDO-0117/teeth.summary.json with the row's false labels and each diff's sha256. Checked offline only: each anchor occurs once and each mutated module compiles. No mutant has been run.

Passed. Row enrollment/one-domain-one-winner is green in the same run, 30 of 30 checks true. Two stores are proposed for an unbound domain in four schedules: each clone's store first, one after the other, and each first with the second attempt begun while the first is held inside its registration transaction. In every schedule the first is registered, the second is told domain_store_conflict with the first's identity, the registry holds one whole row, and no row is visible while the first registration is open. The winner's client gets its command accepted naming the winning identity; the loser's client is refused domain_store_conflict naming the same one. The control is two stores of two different domains started the same overlapped way: both register and both serve.
Pending, step green-after: three runs of the suite as built, written to proof/VELDO-0117/green-after.summary.json.

Pending, step red-before: on the modules of f6b8ae41 the row must be red in all four schedules on the check that the second store is told domain_store_conflict. Written to proof/VELDO-0117/red-before.summary.json.

Pending, step teeth: mutant v117-registration-not-atomic removes the transaction around the read and the insert. It must turn the row red in the overlapped schedules, where the second attempt then gets past the first. Written to proof/VELDO-0117/teeth.summary.json. Checked offline only: both anchors occur once and the mutated module compiles. The 3 s overlap window is the one timing bound: a loaded host that delays the second process by more than 3 s between its begin report and its read would let this mutant through.

Passed. Row enrollment/domain-binding-survives-restart is green in the same run, 64 of 64 checks true. After each of the four schedules both authorities are stopped and started again as new processes over the same registry and the VELDO-0115 stores, matching store first and conflicting store first. The committed record, read before and after each proposal, is the winner's identity every time. The winning store restarts under another spelling of its path, with its clone's binding signed over that spelling, and matches; its command is applied. The losing store is told domain_store_conflict again and its clone's command is refused by that name with nothing written.

checks.name: service_wiring
checks.detail: control_service.serve registers the configured store in the domain registry under the lock, before it writes the store, and gives the registry to control_client.Authority. The registry is the path the installation record names as domain_registry, else domains.sqlite3 in the install root. The installer writes no new key. domain_store_conflict has a taxonomy class (invalid_input). engine/.veldo/control_service.py is the same bytes. Proved by the production checks of the AC1 row.

checks.name: refusing_instance_teeth
checks.reason: No mutant covers serve_refusing, the branch that keeps an instance of another store from rebinding, taking on adoptions or opening a channel, API or factory loop. With the branch removed the instance still refuses every command through its authority, and the suite's installations have nothing a full start would write, so no row turns red. The suite does check that the conflicting instance's store is unchanged in every table.

checks.name: other_service_suites
checks.reason: Not run by the builder: the other suites that start the installed service (66_veldo_0047_authority and those after it). Each now creates domains.sqlite3 in its install root and registers its store there. A suite that lists its install root exactly, or installs two stores for one domain in one root, would change; the gate decides.

checks.name: registry_scope
checks.reason: Installations laid down in different install roots share a registry only when each record names the same domain_registry path. The installer has no option for it; the key is written by hand. Nothing checks that two roots on one host agree.

checks.name: scope_limits
checks.reason: Not judged here: one store uuid or one file registered under two different domains. The registry keys on the domain, and the spec's criteria ask about conflicts within one domain. The suite records that such a pair is not called domain_store_conflict.

rollback: Revert the commits of this branch together. The service stops registering and the Authority stops taking a registry, the refusal domain_store_conflict goes away, and suite 46 is back to ten reasons. A registry file (domains.sqlite3 in an install root, or one an operator named) stays on disk and nothing reads it. No store's schema and no installation record changed, so stores and installations written under this change open the same after the revert.
